sources.role: Windows native configuration, input, save-state, Kickstart ROM and encrypted-ROM-key contracts
official source identity and Windows runtime

paths.path: WinUAE .uae configuration file selected by the official Windows executable
paths.naming: input.1.joystick.N.name/friendlyname, axis.N, button.N and joyportN=joyM/joyportNmode=gamepad; exact path is user-selected

paths.path: The same .uae configuration plus WinUAE's native Windows input backend
paths.naming: Measured zero-based joystick device N and source event names JOY1/JOY2_*; matching can require unique and friendly names

paths.path: Inside attached Amiga floppy, hard-disk or CD media; WinUAE does not define a universal host-side per-game save-RAM sidecar
paths.naming: Save files are created by the guest application inside its writable Amiga media and retain guest-defined names

paths.path: Global Save States directory selected in WinUAE's Paths configuration; manual state files may be placed at an explicitly selected path
paths.naming: WinUAE emulator snapshots use the .uss AmigaStateFile format; quick-save slots use the configured state name with numbered suffixes such as _1.uss
evidence: source:cfgfile.cpp path expansion and state-related configuration handling @d9a702b536283ea968c0de7c1991b44181120575

paths.path: Kickstart/system ROM file selected by the WinUAE ROM/Paths configuration (kickstart_rom_file); no single fixed host directory is required
paths.naming: User-selected Kickstart ROM image for the emulated Amiga model; ROM revisions and filenames are ROM-set-specific
evidence: source:rommgr.cpp Kickstart ROM scan and identification @d9a702b536283ea968c0de7c1991b44181120575

paths.path: Optional rom.key file selected by kickstart_key_file for Cloanto-encrypted Kickstart ROM images
paths.naming: Exact configured key filename is user-selected (commonly rom.key); ordinary unencrypted Kickstart ROMs do not use this file

linux.reason: WinUAE is a Windows runtime; Wine is not native Linux compatibility.

linux-flatpak.reason: No native Linux or Flatpak WinUAE runtime.
